mapper.sql: select id, tenant_code, submit_id, employee_id, checked_num, settled_num, adjusted_num, settlement_day, product_seq, operate_process_seq, remark, settlement_status, settlement_no, created_by, created_date, last_upd_by, last_upd_date from micro_settlement_report
mapper.select: SELECT msr.product_seq AS productSeq, mp.product_code AS productCode, mp.product_name AS productName, mp.unit AS productUnit, mpc.process_name AS operateProcessName, mpc.process_code AS operateProcessCode, msr.operate_process_seq AS operateProcessSeq, msr.settlement_day AS settlementDay, msr.tenant_code AS tenantCode FROM micro_settlement_report msr LEFT JOIN micro_process_common mpc ON msr.tenant_code = mpc.tenant_code AND msr.operate_process_seq = mpc.process_seq LEFT JOIN micro_product mp on msr.tenant_code = mp.tenant_code AND msr.product_seq = mp.product_seq WHERE msr.product_seq = #{productSeq} AND msr.settlement_status = '20' AND DATE_FORMAT(msr.settlement_day, '%y%m') = DATE_FORMAT(#{searchDate}, '%y%m') GROUP BY msr.product_seq, msr.operate_process_seq ORDER BY msr.product_seq, msr.operate_process_seq

SELECT msr.employee_id AS employeeId, IF(mu.nick_name IS NULL, mu.user_name, nick_name) AS employeeName, SUM(msr.settled_num) AS totalSettledNum, ROUND(SUM(msr.adjusted_num - msr.settled_num), 4) AS totalSettledNum FROM micro_settlement_report msr LEFT JOIN micro_user mu ON msr.tenant_code = mu.tenant_code AND msr.employee_id = mu.id WHERE msr.tenant_code = #{tenantCode} AND msr.settlement_status = '20' AND DATE_FORMAT(msr.settlement_day, '%y%m') = DATE_FORMAT(#{settlementDay}, '%y%m') AND msr.product_seq = #{productSeq} AND msr.operate_process_seq = #{operateProcessSeq} GROUP BY msr.employee_id

SELECT IFNULL(ROUND(SUM(settled_num), 4), 0) AS settledNum FROM micro_settlement_report msr WHERE msr.settlement_status = '20' AND msr.employee_id = #{employeeId} AND DATE_FORMAT(msr.settlement_day, '%y%m') = DATE_FORMAT(#{settlementDay}, '%y%m')
SELECT IFNULL(ROUND(SUM(msr.adjusted_num - msr.settled_num), 4), 0) AS openNum FROM micro_settlement_report msr WHERE msr.settlement_status = '10' AND msr.employee_id = #{employeeId}
